title: Analytics views over the queue and stored reviews
what: Read-only extensions in lib/queue_ext/ (and a check-stats view over .relay/checks/*.json): queue totals by kind, age and time; findings per reviewer, share MET at first check.
why: The owner wants scripts that handle many items fast and give analytics, reusable by the model for finding information; the model and the owner get answers from one tested script instead of reading many files.
